Furnished Room in 2BR Apt — 298 University Ave W, Waterloo, ON (Winter 2027)

Available Jan 1 to Apr 30, 2027 for $1,020/month (heat, water, and Wi-Fi included; hydro ~$25/mo). Owner lives off-site and has signed our written sublet consent; we'll use the Ontario Standard Lease sublet form. In-person viewings available this week—email univ298@example.com.

Move-in checklist:
- Last month's rent deposit of $1,020 (one month's rent, applied to April 2027)
- Refundable $50 electronic key-fob deposit (exact condo replacement cost, refunded on fob return)
- Refundable $250 furniture & wall damage security deposit (held until post-move-out inspection)
- Strict no-pets clause in the lease (no dogs, cats, or other animals permitted in the unit)
label_rationale: Mixed lawful + unlawful terms test. Lawful elements: 1-month last-month rent deposit (Ontario RTA s. 106(1)-(2)), $50 refundable fob deposit at direct replacement cost (O. Reg. 516/06 s. 17 para. 3), landlord sublet consent (s. 97), and Ontario Standard Lease (s. 12.1). Illegal/void elements: $250 furniture/wall damage security deposit (prohibited under RTA s. 105(1) & s. 134(1)) and blanket no-pets clause (void under RTA s. 14). Not a scam; void clauses trigger HOLD under SPEC D6.
